verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party "Import your mail" help article and a "Move from Gmail" guide. Community users independently describe an "easy migration tool", fetching mail from Gmail like a client, and a smooth move from Google services, so mail-history import is supported. Contacts import is not evidenced anywhere in the pack, and the import docs are cited only by title, with no detail on completeness or supported source providers. missing for 10: evidence of contacts import, documented detail on full-history fidelity (folders/labels, attachments) and supported source providers/clients.
